scope: Proposition 6.1 (Exact vertex representation) of the manuscript “SLE3 universality for weak finite-range Ising interactions” (preprints/SLE3-universality-for-weak-finite-range-Ising-interactions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 44a7837e35328259), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 55. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a finite choice of M such that, for all sufficiently small |λ|, positive functions Wv ( σv, bB(v) ) represent the spin weight in (6.1) exactly, up to a constant, as the spin marginal of ∏ v Wv. Here B(v) is the set of the 4M bits on bonds incident to v. The same functions are used whether a physical spin is free or pinned. There are only finitely many local tables, and uniformly in their entries Wv(σ, b) −→ W0 v (σ, b) := exp ⎛ ⎝aσ ∑ i∈B(v) bi ⎞ ⎠ as λ −→ 0. (6.3) The representation applies to either sign of every sufficiently small local perturbation.
